name: CapArena
description: CapArena is a benchmark platform for evaluating detailed image captioning quality by leveraging over 6,000 pairwise caption battles with high-quality human preference votes. It also includes CapArena-Auto, an automated benchmark that correlates strongly with human rankings.
typical_sota_score: High correlation with human rankings (Spearman ρ ≈ 0.8–0.95 for CapArena-Auto vs human preferences)
reputation: A recent benchmark platform for image captioning quality that has gained attention for using human pairwise preferences and an automated proxy, but it is still emerging rather than a long-established standard.
notes: Includes human preference votes and automated metrics evaluation; CapArena-Auto achieves 94.3% correlation with human rankings.
